expectations.text: The response does not present one price as its forecast and instead gives bull, base and bear scenarios with prices and rough probabilities
expectations.evidence: Opens with a single figure: 'Rs 560. That is my base case for the NABIL price in Oct 2027'. No bull or bear scenario.

expectations.text: The scenario probabilities in the response add up to about 100 percent
The response states the limits of forecasting on NEPSE or that it has no tested edge, and treats the friend's figure of 800 as an unverified claim
expectations.evidence: 'It is one number from simple math, not a forecast. The real outcome can land well away from it' and 'Do not size a position on any single price target, mine included.' On the 800: 'Nothing in the numbers I found points to 800' and 'Ask your friend why 800'.

expectations.text: The response gives the current NABIL price with a date and a source
expectations.evidence: 'Last price I found: Rs 547 on 16 Oct 2026, from a third-party page', sourced to the nepsetrading NABIL tearsheet.

expectations.text: Each scenario has a trigger and the response gives the strongest argument against its base case
expectations.evidence: No scenarios, so no triggers, and no argument against its own Rs 560.
